# Asteroid Dodger

**Concept:** Control a ship that moves left/right at the bottom of the canvas and fires upward to destroy falling asteroids. Earn points for each asteroid destroyed and try to survive as long as possible.

**Lose condition:** The game ends when an asteroid touches the ship or the player runs out of lives.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodger game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship configuration
12:   const ship = {
13:     w: 40,
14:     h: 20,
15:     x: width / 2 - 20,
16:     y: height - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:   };
19: 
20:   // Game state
21:   const bullets = [];
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let lives = 3;
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   // Input handling
28:   // Sound setup
29:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
30:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
31:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
32:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
33:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
34:     osc.type = 'sine';
35:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     osc.start();
38:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
39:   }
40:   function playShoot() { playTone(600, 0.08); }
41:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 0.15); }
42:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
43:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first interaction
44:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }, {once: true});
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
48:   const keys = {};
49:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
51: 
52:   // Create background stars
53: const stars = [];
54: function initStars(count = 100) {
55:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
56:     stars.push({
57:       x: Math.random() * width,
58:       y: Math.random() * height,
59:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
60:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
61:     });
62:   }
63: }
64: initStars();
65: 
66: function updateStars() {
67:   for (let s of stars) {
68:     s.y += s.speed;
69:     if (s.y > height) {
70:       s.y = 0;
71:       s.x = Math.random() * width;
72:     }
73:   }
74: }
75: 
76: function spawnAsteroid() {
77:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
78:     asteroids.push({
79:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
80:       y: -size,
81:       w: size,
82:       h: size,
83:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
84:     });
85:   }
86: 
87:   function update() {
88:     // Update background stars
89:     updateStars();
90:     if (gameOver) return;
91:     // Move ship
92:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
93:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
94:     // Fire bullet
95:     if (keys[' '] && bullets.length < 5) {
96:       bullets.push({
97:         x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2,
98:         y: ship.y,
99:         w: 4,
100:         h: 10,
101:         speed: 7,
102:       });
103:       playShoot();
104:     }
105:     // Update bullets
106:     bullets.forEach(b => b.y -= b.speed);
107:     // Remove off‑screen bullets
108:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       if (bullets[i].y + bullets[i].h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
110:     }
111:     // Update asteroids
112:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
113:     // Collision detection
114:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       const a = asteroids[i];
116:       // Ship collision
117: if (
118:           a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.w > ship.x &&
119:           a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.h > ship.y
120:         ) {
121:           lives--;
122:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
123:           playExplosion();
124:           if (lives <= 0) {
125:             gameOver = true;
126:             playGameOver();
127:           }
128:           continue;
129:         }
130:       // Bullet collision
131:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
132:         const b = bullets[j];
133:         if (
134:           a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
135:           a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y
136:         ) {
137:           score++;
138:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
139:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
140:           playExplosion();
141:           break;
142:         }
143:       }
144:     }
145:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
146:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
147:       if (asteroids[i].y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
148:     }
149:     // Randomly spawn new asteroids
150:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
151:   }
152: 
153: function draw() {
154:     // Background gradient
155:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
156:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
157:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
158:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
160: 
161:     // Stars
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
163:     for (let s of stars) {
164:       ctx.beginPath();
165:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
166:       ctx.fill();
167:     }
168: 
169:     // Ship (draw as triangle)
170:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
171:     ctx.beginPath();
172:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
173:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
174:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
175:     ctx.closePath();
176:     ctx.fill();
177: 
178:     // Bullets (glow effect)
179:     for (let b of bullets) {
180:       const gradB = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, 0, b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w);
181:       gradB.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
182:       gradB.addColorStop(1, '#aa0');
183:       ctx.fillStyle = gradB;
184:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
185:     }
186: 
187:     // Asteroids (draw as circles with shading)
188:     for (let a of asteroids) {
189:       const gradA = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/4, a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2);
190:       gradA.addColorStop(0, '#ff5555');
191:       gradA.addColorStop(1, '#880000');
192:       ctx.fillStyle = gradA;
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);

196:     }
197: 
198:     // HUD
199:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

201:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
202:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, width - 80, 20);
203:     if (gameOver) {
204:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
205:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
206:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
207:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
208:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
209:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
210:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
211:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
212:     }
213:   }
214:   }
215: 
216:   function loop() {
217:     update();
218:     draw();
219:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
